question: What kind of widespread suffering will arise among the people as a result?
premises: Affliction of the people will occur.
It will involve many faults or harms.
inference: There will be disease-causing, manifold affliction among the people.
uncertainties: rogakṛtvā is read functionally as 'causing disease' though its form is unusual.
plain_english: There will be affliction of the people, causing disease and full of many harms.
